it.t: Marks are a family of Debuffs that apply powerful effects to a single enemy, usually for a limited duration. You can have multiple Marked enemies at once, but each individual enemy can only have a single Mark applied to them at once. Marks can be Activated when specific conditions occur, which will cause some extra effect and then Consume the Mark.

Flasks can be used to recover your Life or Mana. Flasks are not consumable, but require charges to use. Flask charges can be regained by killing enemies. Normal enemies grant Flask charges equal to half their Power Magic enemies grant Flask charges equal to their Power Rare and Unique enemies grant Flask charges equal to twice their Power Checkpoints and Wells completely refill Flasks when activated. Flasks can only hold charges while in a Flask slot.

it.t: Shock is an Ailment that causes targets to take 20% increased damage, and lasts 4 seconds on players or 8 seconds on non-players by default. Lightning damage from Hits Contributes to chance to Shock enemies. The higher the Lightning damage dealt, the higher the chance. By default a Hit has 1% chance to Shock for every 4% of the target's Ailment Threshold dealt.

Leech recovers an amount of Life, Mana, Energy Shield, or Rage over one second, usually as a result of Hitting an enemy and based on the damage of the Hit. Only one instance of Leech for each resource can provide recovery at a time.

it.t: Lucky things are rolled twice and the better result used.
Biomes are found throughout Endgame Maps. Grass, Forest, Swamp, Desert, Mountain and Water Biomes are all commonly found. Cities and special biomes are less likely to be encountered.
Debuffs you are Unaffected by can still be placed on you, but will not actually apply their effect.

Any mechanic where the calculation of a single Hit would roll Critical Hit Chance more than once is considered to be Rerolling. This includes anything that makes Critical Hit Chance Lucky, Unlucky, Bifurcated, or Inevitable. Sustained Skills using an independent Critical Hit Chance roll for each different time they deal damage is not Rerolling.
A target is immobilised if it cannot move, for example due to being Frozen, Pinned, Heavy Stunned, or Electrocuted.

Riven Armour is a Debuff inflicted by Hits, which stores 5% of the Pre-mitigation Physical Hit damage of the Hit that inflicts it as its Magnitude. The inflicter's subsequent Attack Hits against the target will gain additional unscaleable added Physical Damage equal to that magnitude. Enemies with Riven Armour cannot get their Armour Broken further.

Curses you inflict have 4% increased Curse Magnitudes for each Dark Whisper you have. You can have a maximum of 10 Dark Whispers. Dark Whispers last for 8 seconds, and this duration is refreshed whenever you gain more. When Dark Whispers expire, you Lose 3% of Life, Mana, and Energy Shield for each of them, over 4 seconds.
Account Bound items cannot be traded to other players, but can be shared between other characters on your account.

Monster Minions are any monsters that are part of a Rare Monster Pack. These monsters receive one modifier from each Rare Monster in the Pack. Monsters summoned or created by other Monsters do not count as Monster Minions.
Every Monster has exactly one Monster Category. These are Humanoid, Beast, Undead, Construct, Demon and Eldritch. Certain Skills interact with specific Monster Categories.

Wild Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit. Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Wild Spirits gain increased Toughness, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type. Monsters Possessed by Wild Spirits drop Strength items.

Primal Spirits are a type of Azmeri Spirit. Monsters Influenced or Possessed by Primal Spirits deal increased damage, in addition to any bonuses from the specific spirit type. Monsters Possessed by Primal Spirits drop Intelligence items.
Monster creates a Mirage when Hit that moves towards enemies and explodes when it gets close enough, dealing Lightning Damage.
Monster has +50% to Lightning Resistance and +10% to Maximum Lightning Resistance.
